canonical_name: Dark-Matter Resolution Density -> Stress-Energy Cross-API Corridor
definition: The DM 2.2 Resolution-level hidden density profile directly REALIZES API 4.3 @energy_density, and API 4.3 @energy_density directly ENTERS @stress_energy_tensor. Therefore the structural component route is already present across the two APIs.
limitations: Does not reconstruct the full stress-energy tensor from density alone.
Does not by itself supply SI calibration or a chosen readable observer normalization.
Does not prove physical dark-matter existence.
